docs.title: AUB: Material Information/Transactions
docs.text:
AUB posts record net income of P12.7 billion in 2025

Asia United Bank Corporation will be issuing the attached press release entitled “AUB posts record net income of P12.7 billion in 2025”.The Press release will be based on the following key highlights:1. Unaudited consolidated net income increased by 12% to P12.7 billion for the full year 2025 from P11.4 billion in 2024.2. ROE and ROA were at 20% and 3.1%.3. Total operating income rose 9% to P23.2 billion. 4. Net interest income to P18.4 billion, up 10% from previous year.5. Net interest margin steady at 4.8%6. Nonperforming loans (NPL) ratio of 0.38%.7. NPL coverage ratio is at 115%8. Total Loan portfolio increased by 13% which stood at P276 billion in 2025.9. Total deposits of P349 billion, which grew by 12% year-on-year10. Low-cost current account/savings account (CASA) deposits grew 25% to P279 billion.11. Other income increased 8% to P4.8 billion12. Total assets reached P435 billion, 13% higher than in 2024.13. Common Equity Tier 1 (CET 1) at 18.4%14. Total Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) at 19.1%
